paper_id: CAME_ Content- and Context-Aware Music Embedding for Recommendation
title: CAME: Content- and Context-Aware Music Embedding for Recommendation
venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
motivation: 传统推荐方法因数据稀疏导致性能受限，而音乐领域存在大量辅助信息尚未充分利用
problem_framing: 如何将内容信息（歌词、标签）与上下文信息（用户行为序列）统一建模以学习音乐嵌入
key_insight: 同一音乐在与其他音乐交互时呈现不同方面特征，需用注意力机制动态捕获这种相关性
method_signature: 异构信息网络结合CNN与注意力机制学习content-context感知的音乐嵌入
evaluation_criteria: HR@10、Precision@10、Recall@10等推荐准确率指标及稀疏数据处理能力
evidence_for_taste: one music piece generally highlights different aspects
play together with various kinds of music
adaptively cope with various aspects of items
attention mechanism enables the pooling layer
capture the key features of music pieces as well as their dynamic relevance adaptively
thinking_moves: 将音乐内容与用户行为数据统一建模为异构信息网络
用网络嵌入方法将高维符号数据映射到低维实值向量空间
通过CNN与注意力机制捕获词级别的局部语义依赖
引入注意力矩阵动态计算音乐对之间的特征相关性
区分一般偏好与情境偏好进行双重推荐推断
cites_own_work: D. Wang, S. Deng, S. Liu, and G. Xu, Improving music recommendation using distributed representation, 2016
D. Wang, S. Deng, X. Zhang, and G. Xu, Learning to embed music and metadata for context-aware music recommendation, 2018
D. Wang, G. Xu, and S. Deng, Music recommendation via heterogeneous information graph embedding, 2017
